summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @servicetitan/va-mfe-loader@1.1.6 declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (versioned zip), unpacks it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a ~727 KB Bun-compiled bundle (// @bun @bun-cjs) with a rotated string/char-code array and index-based decoder that reconstructs identifiers and network destinations only at runtime. setup.mjs itself is obfuscator.io-style minified (_0x488df8-style identifiers, string-lookup wrappers). The published library dist/va-mfe-loader.js is a ~30-line React micro-frontend loader component using @servicetitan/web-components; peerDependencies only reference React and @servicetitan/web-components. A React MFE loader has no functional need for a second language runtime or a 727 KB obfuscated blob at install. The alien-runtime execution path evades Node-based supply-chain scanners by running the payload under Bun rather than Node.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
